name: Artilleryman Style
description: Artillery Vehicle STYLE: An artilleryman wearing armor, which not only retains his traditional costumes, but also adds modern action elements. Bend your legs sideways and half-squat, stretch your left arm forward to the left, point the index and middle fingers of your left hand in the direction of the cannon, and make a fist with your right hand on the waist behind your back. Next to him is a cannon needed for combat. The cannon is a pen holder that can hold 3 pens in total. The assembled model is an exquisite ornament on the desktop, which is both ornamental and practical.
